hero.heading: Heathrow Airport Transfers from Henfield
hero.subheading: Professional, reliable taxi and private hire transfers from Henfield and the surrounding villages to Heathrow Airport — available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

intro.heading: Your Local Heathrow Transfer Specialist
paragraphs: Western Cars Henfield has been providing trusted airport transfer services from Henfield, Billingshurst, Cowfold, Southwater and the wider West Sussex area for many years. We specialise in Heathrow Airport transfers, offering a stress-free, punctual service so you can travel with complete confidence.

Whether you're heading to Terminal 2, 3, 4 or 5, our experienced drivers know the fastest routes and will monitor your flight in real time to adjust pick-up times if your flight is delayed. We take the hassle out of airport travel.

terminals.heading: All Heathrow Terminals Covered
terminals.subheading: We serve every terminal at London Heathrow Airport.

items.name: Terminal 2
items.description: The Queen's Terminal — home to Star Alliance carriers including United, Lufthansa, and Air New Zealand.

items.name: Terminal 3
items.description: Serving long-haul routes with airlines including American Airlines, Emirates, and Virgin Atlantic.

items.name: Terminal 4
items.description: Serving a range of international carriers including Malaysia Airlines and Saudi Arabian Airlines.

items.name: Terminal 5
items.description: British Airways' dedicated terminal — the UK's busiest single-airline terminal.

whyUs.heading: Why Choose Western Cars for Your Heathrow Transfer?
